THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.applies_to: the Threshold for the contract type concerned (Goods & Services, Works, Concession contracts or Light Touch contracts); values on the Procurement intranet page (see also AppB-note-3)

rules.condition: proposed service contract with estimated value exceeding the Threshold for Goods & Services
rules.required_action: consider (and evidence) how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, per the Social Value Act 2012 and Social Value Policy
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: contract must be in accordance with a decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision maker within the Scheme of Delegation
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; or under the Scheme of Delegation an Executive Decision Maker, a Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or an officer or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision: | of the Council; or | of the Executive; or | within the Council’s Scheme of Delegation by: | an Executive Decision Maker; | a Council Committee or Sub-Committee; or | an officer or their delegate for the purpose.

rules.condition: any contract entered into
rules.required_action: contract must be covered by an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council
rules.approver: the Council (approved Budget)
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award with a value over £500,000
rules.required_action: treat the award as a Key Decision of the Council
rules.approver: the Council (Key Decision)
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: Service Director lacks delegated authority to enter into the contract
rules.required_action: obtain approval in accordance with Appendix A before the contract is awarded
rules.approver: as set out in Appendix A
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Service Director does not have delegated authority to enter into a contract, approval in accordance with Appendix A is required before the contract can be awarded.

rules.condition: expenditure exceeding £500
rules.required_action: publish details of the expenditure, including payments to suppliers and contractors (Local Government Transparency Code 2015)
rules.verbatim_quote: Under the Local Government Transparency Code 2015, councils must publish: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.scope: contracts to provide goods and/or services
rules.condition: invitation to tender for a goods/services contract with a value exceeding £5,000
rules.required_action: publish details of every such invitation to tender
rules.verbatim_quote: councils must publish: | Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: contracts in progress and awarded
rules.required_action: publish a register of contracts with key information such as contract value, duration and supplier
rules.verbatim_quote: councils must publish: | A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: every month
rules.required_action: report contract information to the relevant board monthly, in the format required by Procurement Legislation
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.scope: contracts for supplies, services or works
rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: ensure every awarded supplier meets the Council's minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council’s minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.condition: opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold (not a Further Competition under a compliant Framework)
rules.threshold_low_text: above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds
rules.required_action: advertise on the CDP database before the advertisement appears in any other medium
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium

rules.condition: any CDP notice
rules.required_action: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate

rules.condition: any requirement that could be split or disaggregated
rules.required_action: no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation and/or the Rules
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: estimated value more than the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: issue an electronic Invitation to Tender; tenders submitted electronically via the Council's Procurement Portal
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: any electronic tender exercise
rules.required_action: the Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format for electronic tender submission
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers

rules.condition: tenders received before the opening date
rules.required_action: store tenders in a secure portal account locked until the specified opening date and time
rules.verbatim_quote: such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the specified opening time and date
rules.required_action: reject late tenders unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.scope: tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.condition: electronic opening of tenders
rules.required_action: opening conducted by a Procurement Officer, with an audit record maintained on the e-tendering system
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: any quote or tender evaluation
rules.required_action: evaluate against criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: award on the most advantageous / best value quote or tender having regard to the Social Value Policy, not only lowest price, unless exceptional circumstances are approved in advance
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (advance approval of exceptional circumstances)
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.scope: contracts not subject to the relevant Procurement Legislation Rules
rules.condition: waiver of competition for a contract over £24,999.99 on grounds of urgency
rules.required_action: waiver only where the work, supply or service is urgent and delay would likely lead to financial loss, personal injury or damage to property
rules.verbatim_quote: contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance: | for contracts which are not subject to the relevant Procurement Legislation Rules, the work, supply or service is required as a matter of urgency and a delay would be likely to lead to financial loss, personal injury or damage to property; or

rules.condition: waiver of competition for a contract over £24,999.99 at executive discretion
rules.required_action: waiver only at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive, acting lawfully, with reasons recorded in writing
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance: | at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive, acting lawfully, who may proceed in a manner most expedient for the efficient management of the Council with reasons recorded in writing.

rules.condition: any waiver or exception to the Rules
rules.required_action: waiver or exception granted only by the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules

rules.condition: any waiver sought
rules.required_action: waiver sought only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: the S.151 Officer must approve the exception
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend to the Executive; exception report prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.approver: the Executive, on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: the exception or waiver must be fully documented
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must: | be fully documented;

rules.scope: exceptions/waivers where competition is not excluded by Procurement Legislation
rules.condition: any such exception or waiver
rules.required_action: submit a written exception report in advance to the relevant board, with reasons showing the waiver is genuinely required
rules.approver: relevant board (report by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service or Executive Director)
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer approves and records that the reasons were considered and the circumstances are genuinely exceptional
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, consortium etc.)
rules.required_action: seek advice confirming legal entitlement to use the scheme, that purchases fall within its coverage, and that it complies with Procurement Legislation and Council requirements
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that: | the Council is legally entitled to use the Purchasing Scheme; | the purchases to be made do properly fall within the coverage of the Purchasing Scheme; | the establishment and operation of the Purchasing Scheme complies with the Procurement Legislation (where such applies) and meets the Council's own requirements.

rules.scope: contracts subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold
rules.required_action: relevant Service Director produces a written procurement report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation

rules.scope: contracts subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.condition: report produced under 9.1
rules.required_action: keep the 9.1 report for three years
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: any procurement procedure
rules.required_action: keep procurement documentation for three years from contract award
rules.verbatim_quote: Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.scope: contracts as detailed in Appendix B
rules.condition: any contract within Appendix B
rules.required_action: contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: contract sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Legal Services retain all sealed contract documents
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: relevant Service Director formally notifies the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement of the award for the Council Contract Register
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: include the standard clauses of the relevant Standard Form of Agreement
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.scope: contracts using an amended Standard Form of Agreement
rules.condition: Standard Form of Agreement amended
rules.required_action: amended form prepared by the relevant Service Director and approved by the Monitoring Officer or delegated officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: any contract (where appropriate)
rules.required_action: include minimum clauses: scope, time for performance, quality standards, insurance, consequences of non-compliance, legislative compliance, personal data, cancellation for improper conduct/Bribery Act, 30-day payment terms flowed down to subcontracts
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: Service Directors ensure a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed to inform data clauses
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities
rules.required_action: no relaxation of full indemnities unless authorised in writing
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: performance bond required
rules.required_action: bond in a form approved by Legal Services and included in the Invitation to Tender
rules.approver: Legal Services
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.scope: contracts where a performance bond is not required
rules.condition: decision that a performance bond is not necessary
rules.required_action: undertake a written risk assessment
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must: | undertake a risk assessment in writing; and

rules.scope: contracts where a performance bond is not required
rules.condition: decision that a performance bond is not necessary
rules.required_action: seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must: | seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and

rules.scope: contracts where a performance bond is not required
rules.condition: decision that a performance bond is not necessary
rules.required_action: keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must: | keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies need for insurance
rules.required_action: set adequate levels of insurance cover in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must: | in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer set adequate levels of insurance cover

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies need for insurance
rules.required_action: ensure the contractor holds the insurances and the policies are up to date
rules.verbatim_quote: If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must: | ensure that such insurances are held by the contractor and that the policies concerned are up to date

rules.condition: risk assessment identifies need for insurance; construction contract
rules.required_action: ensure the contractor's status under the Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme
rules.verbatim_quote: If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must: | who must ensure the contractor’s status under the Inland Revenue Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme (for construction contracts);

rules.scope: contracts requiring professional and/or design services
rules.condition: risk assessment identifies need for insurance
rules.required_action: set a case-by-case level of professional indemnity insurance with the Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must: | set an appropriate level of professional indemnity insurance for each specific contract that require professional and/or design services

rules.scope: goods, services, works or concession contracts
rules.condition: contract value above Threshold
rules.required_action: contract must be sealed
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.scope: documents executed on behalf of the Council not under seal
rules.condition: document signed rather than sealed
rules.required_action: keep a register of such signed documents
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: award by the relevant Service Director under delegated authority
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing)
rules.verbatim_quote: up to relevant Threshold | Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above the relevant Threshold and below £500,000
rules.required_action: award by the relevant Service Director following S151 and Monitoring Officer recommendation, with a written report approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); report approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000 | Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above £500,000 and below £2.5 million
rules.required_action: Key Decision by the relevant Service Director with the Portfolio Holder, after recommendation by the Executive Director, S151 and Monitoring Officer, with a written report approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer); report approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than £2.5million | The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided: | a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above £500,000 and below £2.5 million
rules.required_action: Key Decision made in accordance with the Constitution's Call-In and Forward Plan procedures
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £500,000 and less than £2.5million | b) such decision have been made in accordance with Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan).

rules.condition: Total Contract Value of £2.5 million or more
rules.required_action: Executive approval required (may be given by delegation following quarterly reports)
rules.approver: the Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: £2.5million or more | Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value of £2.5 million or more
rules.required_action: Executive receives quarterly reports on contracts being procured, seeking delegated authority to award
rules.approver: the Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: £2.5million or more | The Executive shall receive quarterly reports detailing contracts being procured and seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract following the procurement process in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer.

rules.scope: goods, services, works, concession contracts and light touch contracts
rules.condition: Total Value (exclusive of VAT) above £1,000 and below £25,000
rules.required_action: seek at least one quote from an appropriate source
rules.verbatim_quote: Above £1,000 and less than £25,000 | At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods/services Total Value £25,000 or more and below the Threshold
rules.required_action: send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME/VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible
rules.verbatim_quote: Goods and Services: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold | Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: goods/services Total Value £25,000 or more and below the Threshold
rules.required_action: publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: Goods and Services: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold | A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.scope: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts
rules.condition: works/concession/light touch Total Value £25,000 or more and below £500,000
rules.required_action: send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME/VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible
rules.verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 | Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**).

rules.scope: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts
rules.condition: works/concession/light touch Total Value £25,000 or more and below £500,000
rules.required_action: publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 | A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.scope: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts
rules.condition: works/concession/light touch Total Value above £500,000 and below the Threshold
rules.required_action: full competitive tender process; seek at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal
rules.verbatim_quote: Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold | Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.scope: Goods and Services, Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts
rules.condition: Total Value above the Threshold
rules.required_action: follow Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders (where appropriate) via the Procurement Portal
rules.verbatim_quote: Goods and Services Works, Concession contracts and Light Touch contracts: Above Threshold | Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.scope: contracts excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.condition: competition not run because the contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (and the relevant board where applicable)
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation. | Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.scope: contracts governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.condition: contract awarded under PSR
rules.required_action: record key decisions and follow the relevant PSR process
rules.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) | Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.scope: contracts awarded under a Purchasing Scheme
rules.condition: award under a Purchasing Scheme without further competition
rules.required_action: obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (and the relevant board where applicable)
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is being awarded under a Purchasing Scheme (refer to 8 above) | Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: extension where the existing contract provides for it
rules.required_action: obtain approval of the S151 Officer for the extension
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is an extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension. | Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation of scope; contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is a variation of the scope of an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such a variation or where the variation is a modification permitted under the Procurement Legislation. | For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: variation of scope; contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: relevant board approval following an extension report with recommendation from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.approver: relevant board (on recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is a variation of the scope of an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such a variation or where the variation is a modification permitted under the Procurement Legislation. | For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.scope: listed individual social care services (placements, supported living, SEN placements, personalised packages, Shared Lives)
rules.condition: provider chosen without competition under row F
rules.required_action: record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual's case notes
rules.verbatim_quote: The contract is for the following social care services: | Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.scope: contracts where an Appendix C exemption is applied
rules.condition: exemption applied and annual or total value more than the Threshold
rules.required_action: contract approved by the relevant board
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.

excluded.reason: Introduction: statutory basis and definitions (Procurement Legislation, Threshold, procuring, entering a contract); no requirement
Purpose of the Rules: background, no requirement
Scope of application (definition of what the Rules cover); no requirement of its own
Assigns interpretation of the Rules to the Monitoring Officer; governance role with no observable test on procurements
Extends the Rules to school governing bodies; compliance is tested through the other rules, no distinct requirement
Broad duty to follow Best Value, Equality and Social Value policies; no defined pass/fail criterion
States that appendices are annexed; no requirement
List stem (transparency obligation background); its item 5.1.1 is entered as a rule
General responsibility to comply with law, Constitution and guidance; restates other requirements, no distinct test
Order of precedence between sources: interpretation
Permissive description of compliant processes ('may include'); no requirement
Says threshold values are published on the intranet; values not printed (see parameters)
Guidance on PA2023/PCR2015 transitional arrangements; procurement team will advise
General presumption in favour of competition: background
Non-mandatory wording ('should be done'); mandatory CDP advertising is tested under 6.10
Permissive ('can be used'); no requirement
Ambiguous: 'potential cross border interest' is undefined and refers to 'member states'; no testable criterion
Describes the procedures available under PA2023; no requirement
Advisory: care and advice 'as necessary' on choice of procedure; no observable pass/fail
Definition of Total Contract Value
Non-mandatory: officers 'should ... seek advice' on repeat purchases; aggregation itself is tested under 6.16
General procurement principles (fairness, transparency, probity); no pass/fail criterion
Heading only ('Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders') numbered as a clause; no requirement
Defers to legislative evaluation provisions; advice 'may be sought'; no Rule-specific criterion
Cross-reference to Appendix C exclusions; the rows are entered separately
List stem for waiver circumstances; items 7.2.1 and 7.2.2 are entered as rules
List stem ('Exception values and delegations'); items entered separately
Ambiguous: garbled 'provided and an exception report'; unclear whether board approval is a condition and who approves
List stem; items 7.5.1-7.5.3 entered as rules
Restates approvals already required elsewhere in the Rules; no distinct test
Defers to waiver conditions in the Procurement Legislation; needs legal judgment, no Rule-specific criterion
Cross-reference to Appendix C (duplicates 7.1)
Definition of a Purchasing Scheme
States the exemption for Purchasing Schemes; advice 'should be sought' is non-mandatory
Non-mandatory wording ('There should be written evidence'); written contracts are tested under 10.2
Non-mandatory: Service Director 'should consider' requiring a performance bond
List stem; items 11.4.1-11.4.3 entered as rules
List stem; 'should be assessed for risk' is non-mandatory; items 11.5.1-11.5.4 entered as rules
Custody and use of the Seal: outside procurement audit scope
Signature of documents for legal proceedings: outside procurement audit scope
Selection and instruction of Counsel: outside procurement audit scope
Footnote *: definitions of SME and VCSE
Footnote **: policy statement on SME/VCSE/local suppliers; no requirement
Footnote ***: three threshold categories exist; values on intranet, not printed (see parameters)
Footnote ****: cross-reference to the local supplier policy for a definition

notes.note: Document title has a blank Part number placeholder; the Rules' position in the Constitution is not stated.
notes.verbatim_quote: Part [] Contract Rules

notes.note: Numbering jumps 5.1.1 -> 5.2 -> 5.2.1: 5.2 and 5.2.1 read as further items under the 5.1 list of things councils must publish, not as new clauses.
notes.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

notes.note: 6.23 is numbered like a clause but is only a heading; it contains no requirement.
notes.verbatim_quote: Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders

notes.note: 'Potential cross border interest' is undefined and the clause refers to 'member states', apparently carried over from EU-era wording; no testable criterion.
notes.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is of potential cross border interest then it must be publicised to ensure that tenderers from other member states have an opportunity to participate

notes.note: Bound printed in pence ('more than £24,999.99') recorded as threshold_low 25000 inclusive. The stem also says 'the following circumstance' (singular) but lists two alternatives.
notes.verbatim_quote: contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

notes.note: Sentence is garbled ('provided and an exception report'): unclear whether board approval of an exception report is a precondition, and who actually approves exceptions between the Threshold and £500,000. Auditor decision: clause kept EXCLUDED as ambiguous, so no rule covers who approves waivers/exceptions for contracts above the Threshold and up to £500,000; the auditor should treat this as a coverage gap.
notes.verbatim_quote: the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board

notes.note: Approver for waivers differs: 7.3 lets the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer grant a waiver; 7.5.3 requires S.151 approval for every waiver; 7.4.3 makes the Executive decide over £500,000.
notes.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver | be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer

notes.note: 'Should' and 'must' in the same clause: documenting procurement progress is 'should', but keeping that documentation for three years is 'must'.
notes.verbatim_quote: the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value) | Such documentation must be kept for three years

notes.note: 10.1 says there 'should' be written evidence of all purchases while 10.2 says contracts 'must' be in writing; 10.2's 'as detailed in Appendix B' does not say which value bands it covers (row A starts above £1,000).
notes.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases | All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing

notes.note: Grammar breaks ('in consultation with ... who must ensure the contractor's status'): unclear whether the Service Director or Finance must act and what 'ensure the status' requires; refers to the 'Inland Revenue'.
notes.verbatim_quote: in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property or nominated officer who must ensure the contractor’s status under the Inland Revenue Construction Industry Tax Deduction Scheme

notes.note: Sealing rule lists goods, services, works and concession contracts but not Light Touch contracts, although 1.4 defines a Light Touch Threshold.
notes.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

notes.note: Blank placeholders for the Constitution Parts governing Call-In and Forward Plan; the Key Decision procedure referenced cannot be identified from the Rules.
notes.verbatim_quote: Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)

notes.note: A contract of exactly £500,000 falls in neither Appendix A band ('less than £500,000' / 'Above £500,000'); 4.3 likewise makes only awards 'over £500,000' Key Decisions, while 7.4.2 runs 'up to £500,000'.
notes.verbatim_quote: Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000 | Above £500,000 and less than £2.5million

notes.note: Band is '£2.5million or more' but the cell text applies Executive approval to contracts 'in excess of £2.5million'; a contract of exactly £2.5m is inside the band but outside the requirement.
notes.verbatim_quote: £2.5million or more | Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval

notes.note: Text after the slash is missing ('for the relevant Service Director / to award'), so it is unclear who else may receive delegated authority.
notes.verbatim_quote: seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract

notes.note: A works/concession/light touch contract of exactly £500,000 is in neither row B2 ('less than £500,000') nor row C ('Above £500,000'); no procurement route is prescribed for it.
notes.verbatim_quote: £25,000 or more and less than £500,000 | Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold

notes.note: A contract valued exactly at the relevant Threshold is in neither row B1/C ('less than the Threshold') nor row D ('Above Threshold').
notes.verbatim_quote: £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold | Above Threshold

notes.note: Rows B2/C use a fixed £500,000 boundary alongside 'the Threshold'; the Threshold values are not printed, so if a relevant Threshold is at or below £500,000 the rows overlap or row C is empty. Cannot be resolved from the PDF.

Advertising: rows B1/B2 say a CDP notice 'must' be published, but the higher-value rows C and D say an advert 'should' be placed, while 6.10 makes CDP advertising mandatory above threshold. Auditor decision: no advertising rule is extracted for rows C or D because the wording is non-mandatory; CDP advertising above threshold is covered only by 6.10 and the B1/B2 'must' rules.
notes.verbatim_quote: A contract notice must be published on the CDP | An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

notes.note: Invitations 'must' include an SME/VCSE and a local supplier, but only 'where appropriate and possible', and footnote ** says the Council cannot give preference to such suppliers; the strength of the requirement is unclear.
notes.verbatim_quote: including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**) | The Council cannot give preference to SME/ VCSE or local contractors/suppliers

notes.note: Row C is garbled: a word is missing between 'no further competition is being undertaken' and 'a competition has already been undertaken', and the row ends with a dangling '; or'.
notes.verbatim_quote: of a type where no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken on behalf of the Council or other public sector organisation; or

notes.note: Variation row requires an 'extension report' (wording from row D), and a contract valued exactly at the Threshold is neither 'below' nor 'greater than' it.
notes.verbatim_quote: For contract value below the Threshold | For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report

notes.note: Closing sentence speaks of an 'exemption' although Appendix C lists 'exclusions', and uses 'annual or total value' rather than the Total Contract Value defined in 6.15.
notes.verbatim_quote: where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board
